blocks.heading: Percentage change
lines: Always divide by the starting value.
Percentage points: 40% to 46% is 6 points, but a 15% increase (6 ÷ 40).

blocks.heading: A is x% more or less than B
lines: A is x% more than B: A = B × (1 + x/100)
A is x% less than B: A = B × (1 - x/100)
To find the base, divide: after a 20% rise the price is 600, so the original is 600 ÷ 1.2 = 500.
If A is 25% more than B, then B is 25 ÷ 125 = 20% less than A.

blocks.heading: Successive change
lines: Multiply the multipliers, do not add the percentages.
Shortcut for two changes: a + b + ab/100 = 20 - 25 - 5 = -10.
To undo a change with multiplier m, multiply by 1/m: 1/0.9 = 1.1111, a rise of 11.11%.
